title: Hyatt and PT Citra Buana Prakarsa Sign Agreement for Hyatt Regency Kapal Besar Island Resort
summary: CHICAGO (November 4, 2026) – Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) and PT Citra Buana Prakarsa today announced the signing of a management agreement for Hyatt Regency Kapal Besar Island Resort. The...
body_markdown:
**CHICAGO (November 4, 2026)** –[Hyatt Hotels Corporation](https://www.hyatt.com/) (NYSE: H) and PT Citra Buana Prakarsa today announced the signing of a management agreement for Hyatt Regency Kapal Besar Island Resort. The planned resort will mark the debut of the Hyatt Regency brand in the Riau Islands and support Hyatt’s continued growth in Indonesia.


Located on private Pulau Kapal Besar near Batam, the resort will offer a secluded island setting within easy reach of Singapore and key Indonesian cities. Access will be via Nirup Island, home to the nearest immigration checkpoint, followed by a short ferry transfer to Pulau Kapal Besar. The total journey from HarbourFront, Singapore, is expected to take approximately 50 minutes.


Set amid the natural beauty of Pulau Kapal Besar, the resort will embrace the island’s tranquil lake, mangroves and coastal surroundings, offering guests opportunities to relax, explore and connect with nature. The resort is planned to include 140 thoughtfully designed rooms and suites, alongside a spa, fitness center, outdoor pools and Camp Hyatt kids’ club with indoor and outdoor facilities and an entertainment center. With its secluded island setting and range of amenities, the resort is envisioned as a destination for a wide range of travelers, whether seeking a relaxing getaway, a family vacation or a setting for weddings, celebrations and group gatherings.


“We are proud to welcome Hyatt to Pulau Kapal Besar as we embark on this new alliance,” said Tommy Ho, Director of Business Development of PT Citra Buana Prakarsa. “The Hyatt Regency brand’s global reputation for thoughtful hospitality is a natural fit for our vision of creating world-class island destinations just a short journey from Singapore. Together, we look forward to hosting travelers from around the world while creating lasting opportunities for our local community.”


“We are excited to collaborate with PT Citra Buana Prakarsa to bring the Hyatt Regency brand to Pulau Kapal Besar,” said Bastien Touzeau, Regional Vice President – Growth, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines, Hyatt. “Kapal Besar’s natural setting and convenient access from Singapore make it an exciting addition to the region’s leisure offering. We look forward to welcoming travelers from Indonesia and around the world with the thoughtful hospitality and attentive service that define the Hyatt Regency experience.”


The resort is anticipated to open in 2031 and will form part of PT Citra Buana Prakarsa’s broader vision for a cluster of island destinations. Alongside its existing resorts on Nirup Island, the company plans to develop neighboring Pulau Layang and Pulau Kapal Kecil.


*The term "Hyatt" is used in this release for convenience to refer to Hyatt Hotels Corporation and/or one or more of its affiliates.*


**About Hyatt Regency**


The Hyatt Regency brand is a global collection of hotels and resorts found in more than 245 locations in over 50 countries around the world. The depth and breadth of this diverse portfolio, from expansive resorts to urban city centers, is a testament to the brand’s evolutionary spirit. For nearly 60 years, the Hyatt Regency brand has championed fresh perspectives and enriching experiences, while its forward-thinking philosophy provides guests with inviting spaces that bring people together and foster a spirit of community. As a hospitality original, Hyatt Regency hotels and resorts are founded on openness—our colleagues consistently serve with open minds and open hearts to deliver unforgettable celebrations, effortless relaxation and notable culinary experiences alongside expert meetings and technology-enabled collaboration. The brand prides itself on an everlasting reputation for insightful care—one that welcomes all people across all countries and cultures, generation after generation. For more information, please visit[hyattregency.com](http://www.hyattregency.com/) . **About Hyatt Hotels Corporation**


Hyatt Hotels Corporation, headquartered in Chicago, is a leading global hospitality company guided by its purpose – to care for people so they can be their best. As of September 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio included more than 1,500 hotels and all-inclusive properties in 84 countries across six continents. The Company's offering includes brands in the *Luxury Portfolio* , including ***Park Hyatt*** ®, ***Alila*** ®, ***Miraval*** ®, ***Impression by Secrets*** , and ***The Unbound Collection by Hyatt*** ®; the *Lifestyle Portfolio* , including ***Andaz*** ®, ***Thompson Hotels*** ®, ***The Standard*** ®, ***Dream*** ® ***Hotels*** , ***The StandardX*** ®, ***Breathless Resorts & Spas*** ®, ***JdV by Hyatt*** ®, ***Bunkhouse*** ® ***Hotels*** , and ***Me and All Hotels*** ; the *Inclusive Collection* , including ***Zoëtry*** ® ***Wellness & Spa Resorts*** , ***Hyatt Ziva*** ®, ***Hyatt Zilara*** ®, ***Secrets*** ® ***Resorts & Spas*** , ***Dreams*** ® ***Resorts & Spas*** , ***Hyatt Vivid*** ® ***Hotels & Resorts*** , ***Bahia Principe Hotels & Resorts, Alua Hotels & Resorts*** ®, and ***Sunscape*** ® ***Resorts & Spas*** *;* the *Classics Portfolio* , including ***Grand Hyatt*** ®, ***Hyatt Regency*** ®, ***Destination by Hyatt*** ®, ***Hyatt Centric*** ®, ***Hyatt Vacation Club*** ®, and ***Hyatt*** ®; and the *Essentials Portfolio* , including ***Caption by Hyatt*** ®, **Unscripted by Hyatt** ®, ***Hyatt Place*** ®, ***Hyatt House*** ®, ***Hyatt Studios*** ®, **Hyatt Select** ® **,** and ***UrCove*** . Subsidiaries of the Company operate the World of Hyatt® loyalty program, ALG Vacations®, Mr & Mrs Smith®, Unlimited Vacation Club®, Amstar® DMC destination management services, and Trisept Solutions® technology services. For more information, please visit *www.hyatt.com* .


**About PT Citra Buana Prakarsa**


Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Batam, Indonesia, PT Citra Buana Prakarsa is a property developer with a hospitality portfolio of more than 1,400 keys, alongside residential, commercial and industrial real estate. The company develops island resort destinations in its home region, a short ferry journey from Singapore, with a focus on attracting international visitors, creating local employment and supporting the region’s growth as a leisure destination. For more information, visit[www.citrabuanaprakarsa.com](http://www.citrabuanaprakarsa.com/) .
